archimate:Value.name: Financial Stability
archimate:Value.documentation:
An enduring state of financial health where a healthcare organization effectively balances its operational costs, revenue streams, and funding to remain viable and resilient.
It ensures the organization has the liquidity and financial health required to invest in modern technologies, maintain continuous clinical operations, and weather economic shifts without compromising patient care.
Example: "Maintaining a stable operating margin that allows the hospital network to consistently fund payroll, upgrade medical equipment, and avoid budget deficits."
